# _Information_

Fishing is an in-game feature that allow the player to use a [fishing pole](https://trello.com/c/rKrk84ur/169-content-list-of-fishing-poles "‌"), [baits](https://trello.com/c/EFm45nhI/173-content-list-of-baits "‌") and [fishing accessories](https://trello.com/c/Xl64kArH/199-content-list-of-fishing-accessories "‌"), which can be equipped in [Profile](https://trello.com/c/mxxBExku/162-profile "‌"), to fish on a pond during the in-game match. You’ll get a drop loot upon fished up something from a pond.

**About Fishing Power:**

- What is Fishing Power? Fishing Power is value of fishing luck that allow the player to have more chance to fished up a rarer loot from fishing.
- You can gain more Fishing Power by equipping a better [fishing pole](https://trello.com/c/rKrk84ur/169-content-list-of-fishing-poles "‌"), [baits](https://trello.com/c/EFm45nhI/173-content-list-of-baits "‌") and [fishing accessories](https://trello.com/c/Xl64kArH/199-content-list-of-fishing-accessories "‌").
- The current weather inside the match does affected Fishing Power. [Rain](https://trello.com/c/G0V4Ij38/156-rain "‌") and [Storm](https://trello.com/c/wgplIGWv/165-storm "‌") boost the Fishing Power, while [Windy](https://trello.com/c/U0FZA86Z/157-windy "‌") lowered the Fishing Power.

**Fishing Loots:**

Plentiful

- [Bass](https://trello.com/c/cd0AzAYL/184-bass "‌")
- [Flounder](https://trello.com/c/8Uq72LOW/296-flounder "‌")

Common

- [Salmon](https://trello.com/c/bIW1ObHA/186-salmon "‌")
- [Rock Lobster](https://trello.com/c/e07WOj4W/297-rock-lobster "‌")

Uncommon

- [Damselfish](https://trello.com/c/kENHnXCH/185-damselfish "‌")
- [Wooden Crate](https://trello.com/c/pftd5r3n/93-wooden-crate "‌")
- [Zombie Merman](https://trello.com/c/GBSn5gNf/192-zombie-merman "‌") (?)
- [Wandering Eye Fish](https://trello.com/c/DxKlHtni/193-wandering-eye-fish "‌") (?)
- [Oyster](https://trello.com/c/TrLN2dM0/287-oyster "‌")

Rare

- [Old Shoe](https://trello.com/c/g1A8Hetd/187-old-shoe "‌") (?)
- [Tin Can](https://trello.com/c/NrBTWsom/208-tin-can "‌") (?)
- [Seaweed](https://trello.com/c/OTmMHNYi/209-seaweed "‌") (?)
- [Iron Crate](https://trello.com/c/IMxvzq8A/94-iron-crate "‌")

Very Rare

- [Platinum](https://trello.com/c/VhVSDcKq/352-platinum-coins "‌")

- [Advanced Combat Technique](https://trello.com/c/iXZXUilA/198-advanced-combat-technique "‌")
- [Oasis Crate](https://trello.com/c/sR22utIX/286-oasis-crate "‌")

Extremely Rare

- [Golden Crate](https://trello.com/c/qUq1dfQv/95-golden-crate "‌")
- [Frog Leg](https://trello.com/c/wFtatr8O/202-frog-leg "‌")
- [Balloon Pufferfish](https://trello.com/c/aETSfaXg/201-balloon-pufferfish "‌")
- [Zephyr Fish](https://trello.com/c/0yqR1bsx/195-zephyr-fish "‌") (Pity - 2000)

# _Information_

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)
- Solidifier - Obtained by killing [King Slime](https://trello.com/c/JwwjtgJV/25-king-slime "‌")

- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained by beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")
- Extractinator - Dropping from [Frozen Crate](https://trello.com/c/tgQ4T91Z/471-frozen-crate "‌") (12%)

- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)

- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained by beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")

# _Information_

**Enemies** is a set of characters that was going against the player during the match, they can be fended off by using units against them. When they were defeated by the player, an information about them will be unlocked inside of [Bestiary](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌"). Noteably each enemy will have their own item drop lootpool when they get killed, and that also included their own [Milestones](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌") which provide a specific reward after reaching a required amount of kills on that enemy.

Each enemy will mainly have 6 stats being:

- **Health** - a stats value of an amount of health the enemy will have during the match, they can be increased by an amount of level the enemy have.
- **Speed** - a stats value of how fast the enemy can move during the match, the higher value, the faster they can move. This stats can be increased by +10% in Expert Mode, and +20% in Master Mode.
- **Defense** - a stats value of how much damage reduction the enemy will take from a unit. If a unit have DMG input less than the amount of Defense the enemy have, they’ll deal 1 DMG against the enemy.
- **Mana** - a stats value of how much mana drop from the enemy when they get killed by a unit.
- **XP** - a stats value of how much XP drop from the enemy when they get hit or killed by a unit.

There are 3 types of enemies being:

- **Regular enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned normally during the match by their wave structure. It’s a default setting for an enemy.
- **Boss enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned in the last wave of a specific Act. They’ll be a boss fight that the player will be going up against, having a big amount of health and an ability that will make them threatening to make the player lost a match. They’re also immune to debuff like [Burning](https://trello.com/c/v9UFWUtB/301-burning "‌").
- **Event enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned in the specific occasion likes during rain or blood moon. They’ll replacing some of existing enemy in the wave structure, and they can be both regular or boss enemy.

###### See more in [List of Enemies](https://trello.com/c/S6VDHpGV/135-content-list-of-enemies "‌")

# _Information_

**Units** is a set of characters that can be used for creating a defense against Enemies, they can obtained in various way likes beating a match or a chance to drop in a specific way. Each unit can be leveled up to level 25.

They’ll have mainly have 6 stats in total being: DMG, SPA and RNG, Accessory, Placement, Mana Cost, and some will have unique stats being: Splash, Globe and Penetration. They’re capable of using [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌") to give themself stats buffs or a passive ability. Their stats can also be boosted by [reforgement](https://trello.com/c/f4XG3UpZ/49-reforges "‌").

**What does each stats do**?

- Regular Stats
  - **DMG** is a stats value of how much damage the unit will dealt against an enemy.
  - **SPA** is a stats value of how fast the unit can attack against an enemy. Its an acronym of “Second Per Attack”.
  - **RNG** is a stats value of how far the range the unit have, to see an enemy in their range to attack.
  - **Accessory** is a stats value of an amount of accessory a unit can equips in their [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌").
  - **Placement** is a stats value of an amount of placement a unit can be placed during the match.
  - **Mana Cost** is a stats value of how much mana is needed for a unit to be placed or upgraded.
- Unique Stats
  - **Splash** is a stats value of the size of splash area of effect.
  - **Perserve** is a percentage stats value of the damage is kept across each subsequent chained attack.
  - **Max Chain** is a stats value of the amount of chained hit on an enemy.
  - **Globe** is a stats value of the amount of an enemy hit in the globe area of effect.
  - **Penetration** is a stats value of penetration against enemy’s Defense  stats.
  - **Percentage** is a stats value of bonus damage dealt against an enemy, using their max HP for calculation. This however limited at 100 damage at maximum.
  - **Confusion** is a stats value of debuff duration for inflicting [Confusion](https://trello.com/c/E5LEaTjH/292-confusion "‌").
  - **Crit** is stats values that display the chance and the damage multiplier of a critical hit.
  - **Knockback** is a stats value that display the distance of the enemy getting knocked back.
  - **Knockback Chance** is a stats value that tells the chance of Knockback to be activitated.
  - **Bad Luck** is a stats value of debuff display a percentage of increased chance for an enemy to be landed with a critical hit when was inflicted by [Bad Luck](https://trello.com/c/H5jPVgkC/448-bad-luck "‌").

**What does leveling up do?**

- Leveling up a unit will provide them +2% DMG boost for the each time they leveled up. After level 25, they’ll only provide +1% DMG boost.
- They'll need to gain 26,150 XP to reach to level 25. Which was the maximum level without the process of appendation.
  - Note: the formula for amount XP needed for level up is: 100+20*(Level)^1.5
- You can increases max unit level by appending boss [Trophies](https://trello.com/c/FQZtfIQ0/322-sub-content-trophies "‌") or [Relics](https://trello.com/c/wDQYXOTi/323-sub-content-relics "‌").

###### See more in [List of Units](https://trello.com/c/S42RuYGn/134-content-list-of-units "‌")

# _Information_

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)
- Solidifier - Obtained by killing [King Slime](https://trello.com/c/JwwjtgJV/25-king-slime "‌")
- Furnace - 5 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s), 3 [Torch](https://trello.com/c/2bZG8f4v/122-torch "‌")(s), 20 Stone(s)
- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained by beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)

- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins

# _Information_

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)
- Solidifier - Obtained by killing [King Slime](https://trello.com/c/JwwjtgJV/25-king-slime "‌")
- Furnace - 5 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s), 3 [Torch](https://trello.com/c/2bZG8f4v/122-torch "‌")(s), 20 Stone(s)
- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained from beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")
- Extractinator - Dropping from [Frozen Crate](https://trello.com/c/tgQ4T91Z/471-frozen-crate "‌") (12%)

Crafting Recipe:

- Using Workbench
  - Forest
    - [Wood Breastplate](https://trello.com/c/RqC8qVcx/58-wood-breastplate "‌") - 25 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)
    - [Wooden Pole](https://trello.com/c/XgXoZtT7/170-wooden-pole "‌") - 125 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)

    - [Slime Crown](https://trello.com/c/D4s7rLDh/117-slime-crown "‌") - 25 [Gel](https://trello.com/c/4En2fRSQ/102-gel "‌")(s), [Gold Crown](https://trello.com/c/YgeV6HWp/72-gold-crown "‌")
    - [Wooden Greaves](https://trello.com/c/9FyVnrwG/59-wood-greaves "‌") - 25 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)

- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained by beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Matches** is a fundamental part of gameplay in [Terraria TD Remastered](https://trello.com/c/eNroKEMx/1-terraria-td-remastered "‌"). It allow the player to play the game, obtain items and unlocks many of things. On each match, it divided by having multiple biomes and each biome have multiple stages or “Acts”. Upon clearing an Act, you get a set of reward that will allow you progress further into the game.
Each Acts have 4 main difficulties, being: Journey, Classic, Expert and Master. These determined the difficulty of a gameplay in the match, as Journey difficulty being the easiest while Master difficulty being the hardest of those Acts. Other than the more difficult gameplay in the match, it also provide a stats increase to an enemy too.

Here are the list of stats change on an enemy
**Enemy stats multipliers:**

- Item drop - 1x → 1.6x (Journey → Master) or +20% from Classic to Master difficulty
- Speed - 1x → 1.2x (Journey-Classic → Master or +10% from Expert to Master diffculty

In some specific matches or Acts, there’ll be a “Modifier” that provide an event during the match. Giving an additional challenge or environmental changes throughout the match.

**The list of an Act with Modifier:**

- [Act 3 Desert](https://trello.com/c/BcSRAyEm/241-desert-act-1-3 "‌") - [Storm](https://trello.com/c/wgplIGWv/165-storm "‌") (Stormy weather is guaranteed)
- [Act 4 Desert](https://trello.com/c/QjZvqmUP/310-desert-act-4-5 "‌") - Antlion Frenzy ([Antlions](https://trello.com/c/UDClFKtj/245-antlion "‌") spawn more frequently)

After completed the final Act of an biome, the Act+ of that biome wil be unlocked allowed the player to do an endless wave of enemies with the long duration of being alive means an exclusive reward of wave milestones. More information will be in [Content - Act+](https://trello.com/c/SXQqvdgX/355-content-biomes-act "‌").

###### See more in [List of Biomes](https://trello.com/c/xLwiiOfV/133-content-biomes "‌")

# _Information_

**About Act+**

- Act+ is an endless gamemode difficulty that the longer the run, the harder it gets. You can only choose Classic difficulty for the gamemode. Every 10th wave will spawn a boss of their respective Act’s biome, if there was more than one bosss then there will be a switcheroo between bosses in every 10th of waves. There are sets of milestones for completing certain amount of waves, with the 100th wave being the last reward of each biome.
- Act+ rewarded the player a [Platinum](https://trello.com/c/VhVSDcKq/352-platinum "‌") at the end of every 10th wave cycle, and increased the amount by 1 for every 20th wave per cycle.
- Act+ started with Journey difficulty, then rise to Classic difficulty on Wave 26, then Expert difficulty on Wave 51 and finally Master difficulty on Wave 76.
- [Modifer](https://trello.com/c/Nbb7xlaJ/326-about-modifiers "‌") gets added on every 3 waves of the match. You’ll have 3 options to pick, they can be either: a positive modifer, a negative modifier or a bargain that allow you to get both positive and negative modifiers. Each option varied by rarity of three being: Common, Rare and Legendary.

# **List of Biomes Act+ (2)**

- [Forest Act+](https://trello.com/c/H6iVwfYs/343-forest-act "‌")
- [Desert Act+](https://trello.com/c/nyByy2hX/344-desert-act "‌")

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Enemies** is a set of characters that was going against the player during the match, they can be fended off by using units against them. When they were defeated by the player, an information about them will be unlocked inside of [Bestiary](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌"). Noteably each enemy will have their own item drop lootpool when they get killed, and that also included their own [Milestones](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌") which provide a specific reward after reaching a required amount of kills on that enemy.

Each enemy will mainly have 6 stats being:

- **Health** - a stats value of an amount of health the enemy will have during the match, they can be increased by an amount of level the enemy have.
- **Speed** - a stats value of how fast the enemy can move during the match, the higher value, the faster they can move. This stats can be increased by +10% in Expert Mode, and +20% in Master Mode.
- **Defense** - a stats value of how much damage reduction the enemy will take from a unit. If a unit have DMG input less than the amount of Defense the enemy have, they’ll deal 1 DMG against the enemy.
- **Mana** - a stats value of how much mana drop from the enemy when they get killed by a unit.
- **XP** - a stats value of how much XP drop from the enemy when they get hit or killed by a unit.

There are 3 types of enemies being:

- **Regular enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned normally during the match by their wave structure. It’s a default setting for an enemy.
- **Boss enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned in the last wave of a specific Act. They’ll be a boss fight that the player will be going up against, having a big amount of health and an ability that will make them threatening to make the player lost a match. They’re also immune to debuff like [Burning](https://trello.com/c/v9UFWUtB/301-burning "‌").
- **Event enemy** - a type of enemy that’ll be spawned in the specific occasion likes during rain or blood moon. They’ll replacing some of existing enemy in the wave structure, this doesn’t apply to a boss enemy.

###### See more in [List of Enemies](https://trello.com/c/S6VDHpGV/135-content-list-of-enemies "‌")

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Armors** is a set of [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌") that can be equipped by units. They will provide a stats buff/debuff to the unit, making them more viable, sometimes for a specific circumstance. You can equip 3 pieces of armor on a unit.

There are 2 type of buffs being:

- **Multiplicative** - A stats buff increases by multiplying a value into the stats. (Example. adding 1.1x RNG to a 30 RNG unit, the RNG stats will be 33 RNG)
- **Additive** - A stats buff increases by adding a value into the stats. (Example. adding +3 RNG to a 15 RNG unit, the RNG stats will be 18 RNG)

###### See more in [List of Armors](https://trello.com/c/RnKGk1v2/138-content-list-of-armors "‌")

# _Information_

**About Crafting:**

- Crafting is a feature used to craft items using materials . Can be either Weapons, Armors, Accessories, and even Consumables.
- Extractinator is a part of Crafting Stations, though doesn’t actually craft anything but extract an item from some material items.

**Crafting Stations:**

- Workbench - 3 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s)
- Solidifier - Obtained by killing [King Slime](https://trello.com/c/JwwjtgJV/25-king-slime "‌")
- Furnace - 5 [Wood](https://trello.com/c/kit2LzvQ/101-wood "‌")(s), 3 [Torch](https://trello.com/c/2bZG8f4v/122-torch "‌")(s), 20 Stone(s)
- Anvil - 5 Iron Bar(s)
- Cooking Pot - Bought from [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌") for 2,500 Coins
- Alchemy Table - Obtained by beating [Snow Act 1](https://trello.com/c/pxwpJX9M/488-snow-act-1-4 "‌")
- Extractinator - Dropping from [Frozen Crate](https://trello.com/c/tgQ4T91Z/471-frozen-crate "‌") (12%)

# _Information_

**About Reforgement:**

- Reforgement is one the feature in Unit menu, allows the player to use [Hammer](https://trello.com/c/4lswNvjw/115-hammer "‌") and give their unit a random reforge, which gives the unit a stats modifer. [Golden Hammer](https://trello.com/c/sMzSMazm/120-golden-hammer "‌") can be used to choose which reforge you want.

**Reforges:**

- None - No stats change (35%)
- Sharp - 1.1x DMG (25%)
- Large - 1.15x RNG (15%)
- Light - 0.85x SPA, 0.9x RNG (10%)
- Powerful - 1.2x DMG, 1.1x SPA (8%)
- Massive - 1.05x SPA, 1.3x RNG (5%)
- Frenzying - 0.85x DMG, 0.7x SPA (2%)
- Mythical - 0.75x SPA, 1.2x RNG (1%)
- Unreal - 1.45x DMG (0.5%)
- Legendary - 1.35x DMG, 0.8x SPA (0.2%)

# _Information_

Settings is a menu for optional setting that affect the quality of gameplay experience, such as music volume, wave auto skip, and more. This menu also contained [Codes](https://trello.com/c/FcweemXl/2-codes "‌") which can be enter for a reward if it was a valid code.

In Settings:

- Audio
  - **Music Volume (0% → 200%)** - This setting can change the volume of music in-game, both inside the lobby and during the match.
  - **SFX Volume (0% → 200%)** - This setting can change the volume of sound effects in-game, both inside the lobby and during the match.
  - **UI SFX (0% → 200%)** - This setting can change the volume of menu and button sound effects.
- Gameplay
  - **Auto Skip** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It allow the player to automatically skip the wave during the match.
  - **Enemy Stats** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for showing an enemy stats in the overworld, revealing their level next to their HP bar.
  - **Damage Text** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for a text visual that was causes by units dealing damage to an enemy.
  - **Unit Equipment** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for showing set of equipments of a unit when viewing yours or the other people loadout, you need to rejoin the game when toggled on this setting.
  - **Topbar Always Visible** - Keeping every menu buttons visible in the top bar of screen, instead of only while opened a menu.
- Visuals
  - **Attack VFX** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for unit’s attack visual, such as projectile.
  - **Lightning** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for special effects that was happened during the match in the middle of [Storm](https://trello.com/c/wgplIGWv/165-storm "‌") weather.
  - **3D Enemies** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for showing the 3D model of an enemy during the match. Some of enemy may or may not have the 3D model in-game.
  - **3D Units** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for showing the 3D model of a unit during the match. As of currently, there is no 3D model for a unit whose have animated 2D model.
  - **Simple UI** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for menu animations and effects.
  - **Simple Visuals** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for match animations and effects.
  - **Extra Effects** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for an extra animations and particle effects.
  - **Custom Cursor** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for in-game cursor between Roblox and Terraria styled cursor.
  - **Halloween Menus** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting that changes every menu into purple halloween-themed.
  - **Screen Shake (0% → 200%)** - This setting can change the severity of screen shaking visual when a unit with high damage input dealt damage.
  - **Particles (0% → 100%)** - This setting can change the amount of particles appearing on the screen in the lobby and matches.
  - **Accessory Brightness (0% → 200%)** - This setting can change the brightness of some equipments, like Mining Helmet or Angel Halo.
  - **Advanced Effects** - This setting can be toggled on and off. It is a setting for single effects like range pulse, or mana stars flying over your total mana counter.
- Keybinds
  - **Upgrade Unit** - This setting keybind allows the player to upgrade their placed unit during the match.
  - **Max Upgrade** - This setting keybind allows the player to max upgrade their placed unit during the match. If doesn’t have enough mana to max, it will upgrade the unit closest to the max upgrade.
  - **Retarget Unit** - This setting keybind allows the player to change their unit’s targetting.
  - **Sell Unit** - This setting keybind allows the player to sell their unit.
  - **Cycle Units** - This setting keybind allows the player to rotate their unit during the action of placing a unit.
  - **Cancel Placement** - This setting keybind allows the player to cancel the action of placing a unit.
  - **Skip / Start Wave** - This setting keybind allows the player to start or skip a wave in a match.
  - **Ping** - This setting keybind allows the player to ping the other player in a match, creating a yellow marker on the floor for
  - **Harvest Pumpkin** - This setting keybind allows the player to harvest a patch of pumpkin in a match.
  - **Hide UI** - This setting keybind allows the player to hide the in-game UIs.
  - **Reset Keybind** - This setting can reset the keybind back to its default setting.

# _Information_

**Modifiers** is a set of modification that added a challenge into the match. It can be a positive changes that gives the player an advantage against the enemies, or it can be a negative changes that could have ruined the player’s match as it gives the enemies a buff. This “modification” factor is a main features in [Act+](https://trello.com/c/SXQqvdgX/355-content-act "‌") difficulty of the biomes, and in a few acts may have a modifier added-on for a specific theming likes Act 4 of Desert having [Antlion Frenzy](https://trello.com/c/fH5GcrBE/324-antlion-frenzy "‌") modifier as preparation for the [Desert Scourge](https://trello.com/c/o0b6vYql/305-desert-scourge "‌") in Act 5 of Desert.

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Units** is a set of characters that can be used for creating a defense against Enemies, they can obtained in various way likes beating a match or a chance to drop in a specific way. Each unit can be leveled up to level 25.

They’ll have mainly have 6 stats in total being: DMG, SPA and RNG, Accessory, Placement, Mana Cost, and some will have unique stats being: Splash, Globe and Penetration. They’re capable of using [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌") to give themself stats buffs or a passive ability. Their stats can also be boosted by [reforgement](https://trello.com/c/f4XG3UpZ/49-reforges "‌").

**What does each stats do**?

- Regular Stats
  - **DMG** is a stats value of how much damage the unit will dealt against an enemy.
  - **SPA** is a stats value of how fast the unit can attack against an enemy. Its an acronym of “Second Per Attack”.
  - **RNG** is a stats value of how far the range the unit have, to see an enemy in their range to attack.
  - **Accessory** is a stats value of an amount of accessory a unit can equips in their [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌").
  - **Placement** is a stats value of an amount of placement a unit can be placed during the match.
  - **Mana Cost** is a stats value of how much mana is needed for a unit to be placed or upgraded.
- Unique Stats
  - **Splash** is a stats value of the size of splash area of effect.
  - **Perserve** is a percentage stats value of the damage is kept across each subsequent chained attack.
  - **Max Chain** is a stats value of the amount of chained hit on an enemy.
  - **Globe** is a stats value of the amount of an enemy hit in the globe area of effect.
  - **Penetration** is a stats value of penetration against enemy’s Defense  stats.
  - **Percent** is a stats value of bonus damage dealt against an enemy, using their max HP for calculation. This however limited at 100 damage at maximum. Exclusive to [Digtoise](https://trello.com/c/H3fAJkxH/308-digtoise "‌") and [Flinx](https://trello.com/c/Zunm2GwP/462-flinx "‌").
  - **Confusion** is a stats value of debuff duration for inflicting [Confusion](https://trello.com/c/E5LEaTjH/292-confusion "‌"). Exclusive to [Baby Ghost Bell](https://trello.com/c/IH4s2JpC/307-baby-ghost-bell "‌").
  - **Crit** is stats values that display the chance and the damage multiplier of a critical hit.
  - **Knockback** is a stats value that display the distance of the enemy getting knocked back. Exclusive to [Rotten Egg](https://trello.com/c/mlUJyHwD/407-rotten-egg "‌") and [Bat Hook](https://trello.com/c/VD0kGY2j/411-bat-hook "‌").
  - **Knockback Chance** is a stats value that tells the chance of Knockback to be activitated. Exclusive to [Rotten Egg](https://trello.com/c/mlUJyHwD/407-rotten-egg "‌").
  - **Bad Luck** is a stats value of debuff display a percentage of increased chance for an enemy to be landed with a critical hit when was inflicted by [Bad Luck](https://trello.com/c/H5jPVgkC/448-bad-luck "‌"). Exclusive to [Black Cat](https://trello.com/c/GNwIXl9z/400-black-cat "‌").
  - **Attacks** is a stats value of a set amount of attack a unit will make on each attack. Exclusive to [Tiny Deerclops](https://trello.com/c/EvYYwbzK/466-tiny-deerclops "‌").
  - **Pellets** is a stats value of a set amount of projectile a unit will make on each attack. Exclusive to [Houndius Shootius](https://trello.com/c/tvUVcqMP/464-houndius-shootius "‌").

**What does leveling up do?**

- Leveling up a unit will provide them +2% DMG boost for the each time they leveled up. After level 25, they’ll only provide +1% DMG boost.
- They'll need to gain 26,150 XP to reach to level 25. Which was the maximum level without the process of appendation.
  - Note: the formula for amount XP needed for level up is: 100+20*(Level)^1.5
- You can increases max unit level by appending boss [Trophies](https://trello.com/c/FQZtfIQ0/322-sub-content-trophies "‌") or [Relics](https://trello.com/c/wDQYXOTi/323-sub-content-relics "‌").

###### See more in [List of Units](https://trello.com/c/S42RuYGn/134-content-list-of-units "‌")

- Desert Scourge is a boss of Act 5 of Desert biome. It is a grounded boss that can dig into the ground and gain more defenses, then launch itself into the sky, increases its walkspeed temporarily. cards.desc:
# _Information_

Fishing is an in-game feature that allow the player to use a [fishing pole](https://trello.com/c/rKrk84ur/169-content-list-of-fishing-poles "‌"), [baits](https://trello.com/c/EFm45nhI/173-content-list-of-baits "‌") and [fishing accessories](https://trello.com/c/Xl64kArH/199-content-list-of-fishing-accessories "‌"), which can be equipped in [Profile](https://trello.com/c/mxxBExku/162-profile "‌"), to fish on a pond during the in-game match. You’ll get a drop loot upon fished up something from a pond.

**About Fishing Power:**

- What is Fishing Power? Fishing Power is value of fishing luck that allow the player to have more chance to fished up a rarer loot from fishing.
- You can gain more Fishing Power by equipping a better [fishing pole](https://trello.com/c/rKrk84ur/169-content-list-of-fishing-poles "‌"), [baits](https://trello.com/c/EFm45nhI/173-content-list-of-baits "‌") and [fishing accessories](https://trello.com/c/Xl64kArH/199-content-list-of-fishing-accessories "‌").
- The current weather inside the match does affected Fishing Power. [Rain](https://trello.com/c/G0V4Ij38/156-rain "‌") and [Storm](https://trello.com/c/wgplIGWv/165-storm "‌") boost the Fishing Power, while [Windy](https://trello.com/c/U0FZA86Z/157-windy "‌") lowered the Fishing Power.

**Fishing Loots:**

Plentiful

- [Bass](https://trello.com/c/cd0AzAYL/184-bass "‌")
- [Flounder](https://trello.com/c/8Uq72LOW/296-flounder "‌")

Common

- [Salmon](https://trello.com/c/bIW1ObHA/186-salmon "‌")
- [Rock Lobster](https://trello.com/c/e07WOj4W/297-rock-lobster "‌")
- [Atlantic Cod](https://trello.com/c/6R6dhALR/556-atlantic-cod "‌")

Uncommon

- [Damselfish](https://trello.com/c/kENHnXCH/185-damselfish "‌")
- [Frost Minnow](https://trello.com/c/7WerOhpN/470-frost-minnow "‌")

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Weapons** is a set of [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌") that can be equipped by units. They will provide a stats buff/debuff to the unit, making them more viable, sometimes for a specific circumstance.

There are 2 type of buffs being:

- **Multiplicative** - A stats buff increases by multiplying a value into the stats. (Example. adding 1.1x DMG to a 100 DMG unit, the DMG stats will be 110 DMG)
- **Additive** - A stats buff increases by adding a value into the stats. (Example. adding +3 DMG to a 10 DMG unit, the DMG stats will be 13 DMG)

###### See more in [List of Weapons](https://trello.com/c/Uns99bDp/137-content-list-of-weapons "‌")

# _Information_

**Accessories** is a set of [equipments](https://trello.com/c/Jy1xYfqe/161-equipments "‌") that can be equipped by units. They will provide a stats buff/debuff to the unit, making them more viable, sometimes for a specific circumstance. Each units have a set amount of accessory that they can equips.

There are 2 type of buffs being:

- **Multiplicative** - A stats buff increases by multiplying a value into the stats. (Example. adding 1.1x RNG to a 30 RNG unit, the RNG stats will be 33 RNG)
- **Additive** - A stats buff increases by adding a value into the stats. (Example. adding +3 RNG to a 15 RNG unit, the RNG stats will be 18 RNG)

###### See more in [List of Accessories](https://trello.com/c/HKIUaTEf/139-content-list-of-accessories "‌")

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**About Coins:**

- Coins is a basic currency in Terraria TD Remastered, you use them to buy item(s) in [Market](https://trello.com/c/obgYXE2S/105-market "‌").

**How to get Coins**

- Dropping from [enemies](https://trello.com/c/S6VDHpGV/135-content-list-of-enemies "‌")
- Dropping from [Quest](https://trello.com/c/DziQpKaw/131-quests "‌")
- Dropping from some Consumables like crates or boss' treasure bags
- Dropping from avaliable [Codes](https://trello.com/c/FcweemXl/2-codes "‌")
- Dropping from [Daily Reward](https://trello.com/c/QbAgaLes/129-daily-rewards "‌")
- A reward from enemy’s [Bestiary](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌") milestones
cards.name: Coins

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**About Platinum:**

- Platinum is a unique currency that can be used to exchange an item in a trade with the [Traveling Merchant](https://trello.com/c/ed5dWO5d/357-traveling-merchants-trade "‌").

**How to get Platinum**

- Dropping from [Quest](https://trello.com/c/DziQpKaw/131-quests "‌") (very rare, unspecific chance)
- Dropping from some Consumables like crates or boss' treasure bags (rare)
- Dropping from some avaliable [Codes](https://trello.com/c/FcweemXl/2-codes "‌")
- Dropping from [Daily Rewards](https://trello.com/c/QbAgaLes/129-daily-rewards "‌")
- Dropping from [Streak Rewards](https://trello.com/c/QbAgaLes/129-daily-rewards "‌")
- An very rare chance to be fished up with [fishing poles](https://trello.com/c/rKrk84ur/169-content-list-of-fishing-poles "‌")
- A reward from enemy’s [Bestiary](https://trello.com/c/apd6cZQA/164-bestiary "‌") milestones
- A reward from reaching every 10th waves in [Act+](https://trello.com/c/SXQqvdgX/355-content-act "‌") of an biome
- A reward from completing a daily quest (any difficulty)
cards.name: Platinum

cards.desc:
# _Information_

**Description:**

- Mana is a currency used inside a match, you’ll use them to place and upgrade your unit for defending against enemies during waves. cards.desc:
# _Information_

Confusion is a debuff that lasts for a few seconds upon being inflicted. It stunned the target. If it was inflicted on the unit, it made them stop attacking. If it was inflicted on the enemy, it made them stop moving. However there was 5 seconds cooldown for the enemy to be inflicted with this debuff again.

The debuff can be negated by equipping the listed equipment:

- [Shackle](https://trello.com/c/kFTxgjxf/80-shackle "‌")
- [Ocean Crest](https://trello.com/c/9ajpyBjo/315-ocean-crest "‌")

The debuff can be caused by:

- [Baby Ghost Bell](https://trello.com/c/IH4s2JpC/307-baby-ghost-bell "‌") (2s) (against the enemy)
- [Antlion](https://trello.com/c/UDClFKtj/245-antlion "‌") (4s)
- [Albino Antlion](https://trello.com/c/iaUd1UQ6/246-albino-antlion "‌") (4s)
- [Desert Scourge](https://trello.com/c/o0b6vYql/305-desert-scourge "‌") (8s)
- [Deerclops](https://trello.com/c/8CkCfJFH/461-deerclops "‌") (8s)
cards.name: Confusion

# _Information_

About Halloween (October 17th - November 7th)

- Halloween is an event that changed the lobby and matches, allow the player to obtain limited-time halloween theme items during the event. Around the lobby got changed to fit with the theme, the same can said with the map in the [Forest](https://trello.com/c/tF9szKB4/238-biome-forest "‌") biome. There may be some _hidden pumpkins_ to be picked up in the Lobby too.
